home.introText: I started programming in VB at six and have worn many hats since: data scientist, full-stack developer, AI expert and Enterprise Architect (former sysadmin and DevOps engineer). Today I bring together my experience in AI and DevCloudOps and explain technology, in small bits, to businesses through my blog TheRedCode.it and on conference stages.

home.servicesLead: I am currently CTO at Welyk, and I also work as a trainer and speaker on AI, DevOps and cloud native: training for companies and individuals, teaching at ITS institutes, technical consulting and speaking engagements, in Rome and online.

timeline.title: CTO · Welyk
timeline.text: Long-range technology vision for a recruiting-as-a-service (RaaS) startup: technology strategy to accelerate product growth and support business expansion.

timeline.title: Tech Expert · Welyk
timeline.text: I run technical interviews on behalf of client companies, using an approach based on skills, soft skills and growth potential. I work with clients to understand the role and team's needs, and provide detailed feedback on candidates.

timeline.title: Former Innovation & Emerging Technologies Leader · Dedalus
timeline.text: I led the strategic adoption of emerging technologies for operational efficiency, accessibility and sustainability, with cross-functional initiatives on AI, platform engineering and DevSecOps.

timeline.title: Enterprise Architect · Dedalus
timeline.text: I aligned technology strategy with business goals across DevOps, infrastructure, security and application modernization, defining standards and governance models.

timeline.title: Founder · TheRedCode.it
timeline.text: The tech blog I created and run with the contribution of other authors.

timeline.title: Co-host of the Edicola Cloud podcast
timeline.text: With Andrea Saltarello I discuss cloud and tech news, on all streaming platforms.

timeline.title: Trainer
timeline.text: Lecturer at ITS Maria Agnesi (2026) and trainer for companies and individuals, with courses on Docker, Linux, AI for marketing, NLP, machine learning, deep learning, DevSecOps and more.

timeline.title: Collaboration with GDG Roma Città
timeline.text: I collaborate with the GDG Roma Città community.

timeline.title: Cloud Native Days Italy
timeline.text: Speaker and Program Committee member of the 2026 edition.

timeline.title: Huawei Developer Expert · AgilePM® Foundation
timeline.text: Huawei recognition (July 2021) and AgilePM® Foundation certification from APMG International (October 2021).

timeline.title: Tutor at Linux User Group Roma Tre
timeline.text: Short courses on Linux and Python.

timeline.title: Università degli Studi di Roma Tre
timeline.text: Master's degree in Artificial Intelligence (2019), with a thesis on natural language processing applied to emotion recognition. Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, with a thesis on customizing and fixing bugs in coreboot, open source firmware.

values.title: Explain to make it clear
values.text: A concept is clear only when you can explain it to someone outside the field. I do tech communication to lower the language barriers.

values.title: Technology with guardrails
values.text: AI speeds up work but also increases what must be governed: costs, security, sustainability. Humans stay in charge.

values.title: Learning by doing
values.text: Live demos, reproducible examples and code that works: theory matters when you can try it.

faq.q: Do you work remotely or on site?
faq.a: I work remotely and in Rome. For events or projects elsewhere we discuss case by case.

faq.q: Which languages can you work in?
Which formats do you offer for events?
faq.a: Talks, keynotes, lightning talks, workshops and panels. The Events page lists the talks already given.
Message me on LinkedIn with a couple of lines about goal and timing: I will reply with next steps.
It depends on format, duration and number of people. Write to me with a couple of lines about goals and timing: I will reply with a tailored proposal.

faq.q: Which topics can I ask for?
faq.a: Docker, Linux, Kubernetes, DevSecOps, AI for marketing and productivity (prompt engineering, vibe coding), data analysis, data science, relational and NoSQL databases, NLP, machine learning, deep learning, computer vision and more and AI areas such as RAG, agents, security, costs and sustainability of AI: if you do not see your topic, ask.

faq.q: Do you also run technical interviews for hiring?
faq.a: Yes: I run technical interviews on behalf of clients, assessing candidates' skills and potential with rigour and care for people, looking for what the client needs in their own team.

faq.q: How many people can attend the courses?
faq.a: Usually groups of 10–15 people, but I also work with larger groups. Courses are beginner or advanced level and include hands-on labs.

aiAreas.title: AI areas I can work on
aiAreas.lead: For each area I show where I have already presented it: talks, articles and books.

rag.title: Chatbots and assistants on company documents (RAG)
rag.text: Semantic search, embeddings and RAG pipelines that answer citing sources, without making things up.

agents.title: AI agents and automation (MCP)
agents.text: Automated agents and workflows, with reliable context and human control.

selfhost.title: Open source models in-house
selfhost.text: Self-hosting with PyTorch, FastAPI and Kubeflow for privacy, control and performance.

aidev.title: AI in software development
aidev.text: Code assistants and DevAIOps with guardrails: where AI is safe to adopt and where human control is needed.

security.title: AI security
security.text: Prompt injection, filter evasion and adversarial attacks: how they work and how to defend.

costs.title: AI costs (MLOps and FinOps)
costs.text: Optimizing inference and ML pipelines while keeping the cost per prediction under control.

sustainable.title: Sustainable AI
sustainable.text: Assessing and reducing the environmental impact of generative models.

ethics.title: AI ethics and literacy
ethics.text: Understanding what AI does when it decides for us, also in light of the AI Act.

nlp.title: Classic NLP, without LLMs
nlp.text: Keyword extraction, intent detection and sentence splitting with YAKE, scikit-learn and spaCy: fast, controllable and cheap.

xai.title: Explainable AI
xai.text: Understanding why a model predicts what it predicts, with SHAP and LIME.

vision.title: Computer vision
vision.text: Object detection with YOLO, from dataset to training.

quantum.title: Quantum computing for developers
quantum.text: A practical introduction in Python with Qiskit and QuTiP.

health.title: AI and healthcare
health.text: Clinical NLP with open source libraries such as MedSpaCy.

city.title: AI for cities and public administration
city.text: NLP on unstructured data for citizen services and more responsive cities.

a11y.title: AI and web accessibility
a11y.text: LLMs to analyze and improve front-ends according to WAI-ARIA and WCAG.

ops.title: AI for HR, customer care and marketing
ops.text: Automating tickets, documents and content with NLP and LLMs.

datascience.title: Data analysis and data science
datascience.text: From exploratory analysis to predictive models: data cleaning, missing values, feature engineering and model evaluation.
